name: Gary (alligator)
summary: Ms. Sharleen's pet alligator, who wears a cowboy hat at her home on Calypso Avenue, Key Lento.
body: GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) lists Gary as a minor character: the pet alligator of Ms. Sharleen, living with her on Calypso Avenue in Key Lento.
GTA Wiki says Gary appears to be an American alligator and wears a brown cowboy hat.
